properties.name: title
properties.description: Section heading shown in the header row

components.description: Collapsible section used to group form fields or content in settings pages. Header row has title on left, chevron on right. Flat white card with 1px border, no shadow. Divider separates header from body when open.

components.name: LayoutBlocks/base
components.description:
⇄ Base Swap Block
↑ Swap me with another ◇ component instance or ↓ Vertical / -> Horizontal Layout Blocks
🛈 Tips: To swap this instance to a new one:
- Open Assets tab or press Shift + i to search for component.
- Press & Hold: Ctrl + Alt then ⛶ Drag & Drop component instance to this base block to quick replace
